title: GTA 6 Map: Official HD Leonida Map, Interactive, With Secret Spots
h1: The GTA 6 map, zoom to every street
desc: Rockstar's official Leonida map in full HD: zoom in to street names, turn pin layers on and off, and find GTA 6's easter eggs, secrets and key places. No spoilers.
lede: This is Rockstar's official Leonida map at full printable resolution (5775 × 7900 pixels), so you can zoom down to street names. We pinned the places worth knowing and the easter eggs that at least two launch-week guides agree on.
sections:
Prefer a picture? These open full size:

  • Whole map with the easter egg pins
  • Vice City close-up (HD)
  • South Leonida close-up (HD)

Rockstar's own printable poster is free on the GTA VI downloads page.
Before launch, fan-made maps pieced together from leaks went around. You don't need them anymore: the map above is Rockstar's official one. We don't use leaked material on this site.
About twice the size of GTA 5's map, going by what Rockstar has told interviewers; exact square miles are still fan estimates. The full size comparison.
note: The map is Rockstar Games' official Leonida map poster; pins and notes are ours. Pins mark the area a spot is in, from launch-week guides; where guides disagree, the note says so.
faq: Is there an official GTA 6 map?
Yes. Rockstar released a printable Leonida map poster on its GTA VI downloads page. This page uses it at full resolution.
Where is Vice City on the map?
On the southeast coast of Leonida, with Vice Beach and the islands off its east side.
Is there a GTA 6 interactive map?
Yes, this page: zoom in, turn pin layers on and off, and tap a pin for what's there.
